summary: Hal Richardson (left), an Argus correspondent, and 34265 Lieutenant (Lt) George MacAfie 'Max' Luff, a photographer and cinematographer with the 4th Military History Field Team, at the armistice talks at Panmunjom, Korea. In the background are Chinese soldiers or negotiators. The armistice was signed on 27 July 1953.
